The '''House of Vespera''' was the ruling dynasty of the [[Vesperan Kingdom]] and later the [[Vesperan Empire]]. It provided the monarchs who transformed Vespera from a regional kingdom into a global imperial power.

== Kingdom Period ==

The house rose during the consolidation of western Vesperan territories in the seventeenth century. Its authority rested on military organization, control of [[Vespera]], and the creation of durable administrative institutions.

== Imperial Period ==

In 1710, the dynasty became the imperial house of the new Vesperan Empire. The emperor's authority was later tied to state religion, coronation ritual, the [[Imperial Council]], and the idea of universal imperial rule.

== Legacy ==

The fall of the Vesperan Empire in 1949 ended the house's effective rule, though later loyalist and post-imperial movements continued to use its name as a symbol of the old order.
